trust_principles: Procurement notices, amendments, procedures, lots, requirements, submissions and awards are distinct records.
Every procurement object preserves source, document, language, rights, jurisdiction and temporal lineage.
A published notice does not prove currentness, completeness, eligibility or suitability.
Amendments and corrections supersede affected fields without erasing prior versions.
Buyer identity, contracting authority and payer identity remain separately resolvable.
Lots are independently selectable and may carry conflicting, exclusive or aggregate conditions.
Eligibility, exclusion grounds and evidence requirements are evaluated separately and fail closed.
Requirement extraction and response drafting produce candidates or proposals only.
Bid readiness requires all configured gates and exact-version approvals.
Models and workers cannot submit, sign, accept terms, commit price or create an award outcome.
Deadline, timezone, calendar and amendment uncertainty remain explicit.
Commercial calculations preserve currency, tax, unit, exchange-rate and assumption lineage.
Submission receipts and award notices require observed external evidence.
Global coverage, eligibility, win probability and legal compliance are never inferred from reachability.
Imported workspace content has candidate authority only and cannot carry live approvals.
Canonical or externally consequential actions require typed human authority and deterministic preflight.

invariants: Notice versions are immutable and content-addressed.
Publication, correction, amendment, cancellation and withdrawal remain distinct.
Source-native identifiers and text are preserved.
Currentness requires exact-version and amendment reconciliation.
A missing or revoked source contributes zero new material.
Duplicate publications are linked and never silently collapsed.
Buyer and contracting authority identities are version-pinned.
Probabilistic buyer matches remain candidates.
Procedure type never implies legal eligibility.
Jurisdiction and governing rules are explicit.
Unknown payer or authority relationships remain unknown.
Cross-tenant entity links cannot grant authority.
Each lot has independent scope, value, deadline and requirements.
Lot selection preserves inclusion, exclusion and aggregate constraints.
Place of performance is not inferred from buyer address.
Source-native classifications remain alongside mappings.
Many-to-many taxonomy mappings remain explicit.
Lot amendments invalidate affected readiness calculations.
Observed requirements and inferred interpretations are distinct.
Eligibility is scoped to bidder, lot, jurisdiction, time and evidence.
Unknown criteria never pass.
Any active exclusion ground denies qualification unless formally resolved.
Mandatory and optional requirements remain distinct.
Machine extraction confidence cannot establish compliance.
A workspace binds one procurement opportunity version and selected lot set.
Opening requires an approved P07 pursue decision.
Team membership grants no approval or submission authority.
Workspace tenant is resolved server-side.
Strategies and lot selections are immutable versions.
Closed or cancelled workspaces cannot submit.
Every response assertion links to exact requirement and evidence anchors.
Draft text never replaces source documents.
Withdrawn, stale or superseded evidence contributes zero readiness.
Translation remains linked to source-native text.
Signature requirements are explicit and cannot be automated without authority.
Secrets and restricted data are excluded from exports and logs.
Price, cost, tax, discount and evaluated price are distinct.
Unknown tax or currency context blocks final validation.
Currency conversion requires provider, rate, timestamp and method.
Modelled margins are proposals and not commitments.
Commercial assumptions are versioned and reviewable.
A worker cannot commit price or accept commercial terms.
Package preparation and external submission are distinct.
Only typed human submission authority can execute or record submission.
A submission requires current approvals, documents, deadlines and channel verification.
Submission receipt is observed evidence and cannot be fabricated.
Award notice and signed contract remain distinct.
Submission never implies award, contract or realised value.

rules: Unlisted transitions are denied.
Every transition references an exact notice or procedure version.
Corrections and amendments invalidate affected downstream state.
Cancellation or withdrawal blocks future submission.
SUBMITTED_EXTERNALLY requires observed receipt or authorised human record.
AWARD_PUBLISHED requires observed award evidence.
Terminal labels do not imply contract signature or realised value.
Re-entry requires a new version or superseding decision.
Source identifiers and versions are immutable.
Currentness requires amendment and withdrawal reconciliation.
Missing timezone or calendar prevents final deadline claims.
Corrections preserve prior payload and changed fields.
Withdrawn or cancelled notices cannot open new submissions.
Conflicting source publications remain contested.
Notice reachability is not admissibility.
Current views are deterministic projections over version history.
Buyer, procedure and lot references are version-pinned.
Procedure type does not establish eligibility.
Each lot retains independent value, scope and requirements.
Lot-group and exclusivity constraints are explicit.
Classification mappings never overwrite native codes.
Place of performance is evidence-backed.
Amendments invalidate only affected projections.
Unknown lot relationships block aggregate assumptions.
Requirements are atomic, versioned and anchored.
Mandatory, optional and scored requirements remain distinct.
Eligibility is evaluated for exact bidder, lot, jurisdiction and time.
Active exclusion grounds produce FAIL.
Missing mandatory evidence never yields PASS.
Model interpretation remains proposed until reviewed.
Conflicting requirements produce REVIEW_REQUIRED or FAIL.
NOT_APPLICABLE requires explicit rationale.
Amendments invalidate affected assessments.
Legal compliance is not inferred from generic similarity.
Tenant and workspace identity are server-resolved.
Workspace binds one exact opportunity and notice version.
Selected lots are versioned and constraint-checked.
Opening requires an approved pursue decision.
Team membership grants no submission or approval authority.
Readiness is recalculated after amendments or revocations.
Cross-tenant access is denied.
Closed workspaces cannot perform external actions.
Workspace data cannot mutate global procurement records.
Every configured gate must PASS for READY.
Unknown or indeterminate gates never pass.
A single DENY gate produces DENY.
Amendments invalidate impacted gates.
Revoked evidence or approval invalidates readiness.
Deadline checks require timezone and current amendment state.
Document readiness requires exact anchors and signatures.
Commercial readiness requires currency, tax and assumption lineage.
Submission-channel verification is external and versioned.
Readiness never executes submission.
Every response maps to explicit requirements.
Response and evidence versions are immutable.
Missing mandatory sections block validation.
Stale, revoked or withdrawn documents contribute zero readiness.
Translations preserve source text and semantic parity results.
Signature and certification requirements remain human-controlled.
Rights and classification are re-evaluated before export.
Hash manifests cover canonical serialization.
All monetary values retain currency and time.
Tax uncertainty blocks VALIDATED.
Exchange rates are provider, timestamp and method pinned.
Evaluated price is distinct from offered price.
Discounts and options are explicit.
Model outputs cannot commit commercial terms.
Human validation is scoped to exact version.
Supersession preserves prior assumptions.
Package creation grants no external authority.
Submission requires typed human authority and current approvals.
The submitted bytes and hash are recorded exactly.
A receipt requires observed external evidence.
Award and contract observations are distinct.
No model or worker may submit or accept terms.
Late or ambiguous deadlines deny submission.
Award outcomes never derive from workflow completion.
Contract value remains distinct from realised value.
Source-native procurement text is immutable.
Language and script are explicit per segment.
Critical parity mismatch produces DENY.
Critical unknown produces REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Translated requirements never replace source anchors.
Taxonomy codes and buyer identifiers are not translated.
Submission instructions require exact source-version alignment.
Aggregate similarity cannot hide a critical mismatch.
Client-provided tenant and capability context is not authoritative.
Models, parsers and connectors cannot establish compliance or eligibility.
Workers cannot submit, sign, spend or accept terms.
Human authority is typed, scoped and non-transferable.
Submission authority does not create legal, rights or budget approval.
Canonical writes require independent deterministic validation.
Revoked or superseded inputs contribute zero future authority.
Imported approvals, receipts and awards carry no live authority.
Break-glass cannot bypass rights, deadline, signature or submission controls.
Least-authoritative dependencies bound derived records.
